item.title: IMF Asia and Pacific director calls on PM - The Bangladesh Today
item.description: Director of the Asia and Pacific Department (APD) of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) Krishna Srinivasan today paid a courtesy call on Prime Minister Tarique Rahman. The IMF official met the premier at Cabinet Division in the Bangladesh Secretariat here this morning, Prime Minister's Press Secretary Saleh Shibly said.

item.title: PM attends office at secretariat after Eid holidays - The Bangladesh Today
item.description: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman today performed his official duties at his Cabinet Division office in the Bangladesh Secretariat here on the first working day after the Eid-ul-Fitr holidays. item.title: FM calls for global unity to fight against racial discrimination - The Bangladesh Today
item.description: Foreign Minister Dr. Khalilur Rahman has reaffirmed Bangladesh's steadfast commitment to combating racism in all its forms, emphasizing the country's signing of all relevant international conventions on racism and racial discrimination. item.title: Offices, banks to resume today after Eid holidays - The Bangladesh Today
item.description: After a seven-day closure for Eid-ul-Fitr, government offices, banks, and insurance institutions across the country will reopen today marking the return to full-scale administrative and economic activities.
